subject.title: Feature Request: One-click Anthropic authentication (OAuth flow)

question: Should OpenClaw expose Anthropic browser OAuth as an onboarding/auth method, and what consent, scope, callback, token-storage, refresh, account-detection, and fallback contract is acceptable?
rationale: Current main has provider auth seams and existing Anthropic auth paths, but collecting and refreshing Anthropic OAuth credentials in onboarding crosses product UX, provider-policy, and credential-security boundaries that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Approve additive provider OAuth
options.body: Expose a new Anthropic auth method through the plugin after scopes, callback behavior, token storage, refresh, docs, and fallback handling are approved.

options.title: Keep explicit current paths
options.body: Leave API-key, setup-token, and Claude CLI onboarding as the supported Anthropic paths and improve labels or docs instead of adding browser OAuth now.

options.title: Prototype behind an experimental gate
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned experimental OAuth flow only if it is clearly opt-in and does not replace existing Anthropic setup choices.

recommendation.title: Approve additive provider OAuth
recommendation.body: Expose a new Anthropic auth method through the plugin after scopes, callback behavior, token storage, refresh, docs, and fallback handling are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal on the Anthropic auth and Claude CLI migration behavior closest to this request.
